headline: UAE Closes Multiple Beaches Following Gulf Oil Spill Environmental Impact
summary: Authorities in the United Arab Emirates shut down additional beaches along its coastline as an oil spill in the Persian Gulf triggers environmental and operational concerns.
why: The Persian Gulf is a central conduit for global crude tanker transit and regional coastal infrastructure.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Regional oil spills disrupt local maritime logistics and prompt coastal containment measures.
